generationInputs.prompt: A vintage snark poster features a vibrant arrangement of a glistening white viscous liquid, an eggplant, a banana, a red chili, and a green chili, set against a solid background. The poster has a distressed, aged aesthetic, with a muted color palette characteristic of vintage prints. The glistening white viscous liquid is depicted as a prominent, shiny blob, possibly dripping or oozing in a stylized manner. Beside it, a deep purple eggplant is shown, its form slightly exaggerated for artistic effect. A bright yellow banana curves gracefully next to the eggplant, providing a contrasting color. A vibrant red chili and a distinct green chili are positioned near the other items, their individual colors standing out against the muted background. The overall composition is playful and slightly subversive, embodying a "snarky" tone through the unexpected combination of items and the vintage design elements.
